what: trainer-boot-volume.yml review follow-ups (non-blocking, from the manager's review of #14231). (a) The grow step (~yml:194) compares AFTER_G to BEFORE_G, so a re-run after a successful grow ends RED even though the filesystem is already at target. Compare the df size to the target instead. (b) The stale-size bound (~yml:151, a TARGET_GB*10^9 lower bound) cannot tell a stale device from a grown one at tiny increments, e.g. 51 GB from the current 47 GiB (50,010,783,744 B) device. Tighten it: require the size to exceed the pre-resize device bytes AND reach at least the target in GiB minus slack. MEASURED in #14268: OCI size_in_gbs is GiB (the trainer's '47 GB' boot volume is 50.01e9 B).
